configuration.purpose: Test whether dense full peaks trivially provide within-5-ms candidates at wrong times; this audits the diagnostic, not the system score
configuration.population: Same 29 audible objects and E10-incorrect subset as the frozen main diagnostic
configuration.comparison: Weighted fraction with any full peak within 5 ms of actual+shift; compare with actual-centered correct-peak availability
configuration.selectionPolicy: Nearest full peak to shifted center; ties by smaller absolute distance then smaller peak time
configuration.confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels

interpretation: High shifted-center coverage means the actual-centered oracle has substantial trivial selection freedom and is not evidence of deployable selectability
